subject: social_science

concepts.title: Map Scale Calculation
concepts.definition: The map scale defines the fixed ratio between the measurement on a drawing and the actual physical distance on the ground.
concepts.key_idea: Scale translates paper measurements into real-world distances.
question_patterns: calculate the actual distance if the map distance is
find the real ground distance using the scale
how many kilometers does the map distance represent
determine the actual length given the map scale
what is the ground distance for a map measurement of

solution_steps.action: multiply map distance by scale factor
solution_steps.explain: The actual distance is found by scaling up the map measurement.

concepts.title: Types of Maps
concepts.definition: Maps are categorized by their purpose: physical maps show natural terrain, political maps show administrative borders, and thematic maps focus on specific data like climate or industry.
concepts.key_idea: Maps serve different functions based on the information they highlight.
question_patterns: identify the type of map showing natural features
which map displays state and country boundaries
classify a map showing forest distribution
what kind of map focuses on specific information
distinguish between physical and thematic maps

concepts.title: Components of Maps
concepts.definition: Every map relies on three fundamental elements: distance for scale, direction for orientation, and symbols for representing real-world objects.
concepts.key_idea: Distance, direction, and symbols are the essential building blocks of cartography.
question_patterns: list the three main components of a map
what are the essential elements used to read a map
explain the role of symbols in map reading
how do we determine direction on a map
why is distance important in map making

worked_examples.question_pattern: If the scale is 1cm = 5km, find the actual distance for a map distance of {map_distance} cm.

solution_template.explain: Multiply the map measurement by the scale factor.

worked_examples.question_pattern: On a small scale map where 5cm represents {scale_factor} km, find the ground distance for 10cm on the map.

solution_template.explain: Multiply the map distance by the ratio of ground to map.
